basis: ASSOCADS is a charitable trust. Membership gives access to programmes and benefits. It gives no ownership, no share of any surplus and no seat on the Board of Trustees.
feeTerms: All fees are in Indian rupees, for one year and before any applicable taxes, unless stated otherwise.

tenures.name: Multi-year
tenures.extras: The fee is locked for the term.

tenures.name: Long-term
tenures.extras: The fee is locked, plus a Long-Term Member badge, priority seats at events and one free upgrade of category.

tenures.name: Course-duration (students only)
tenures.duration: Until the course ends, up to 4 years
tenures.price: The annual fee for each year, less 15%
tenures.extras: Converts to Early-career Professional at half price for the first year after graduation.

tenureNote: For example, a Mid-career Professional pays ₹3,000 for one year, ₹8,100 for three years or ₹12,000 for five years. There is no lifetime membership.

honorary.name: Founder Member
honorary.granted: The 12 founders named in the trust deed.
honorary.recognition: All benefits. The Board of Trustees and its office bearers come from among them.

honorary.name: Fellow (FASSOCADS)
honorary.granted: By invitation of the Board, for people with over ten years in the field and a visible contribution to it. Up to ten new Fellows a year.
honorary.recognition: The post-nominal title FASSOCADS, advisory councils and priority for keynotes.

honorary.name: Distinguished or Honorary Member
honorary.granted: By resolution of the Board, for eminent figures.
honorary.recognition: Advisory work and a presence at flagship events.

honorary.name: Patron
honorary.granted: A donation of ₹5,00,000 or more, once the trust can accept donations.
honorary.recognition: A named lecture, scholarship or award, and the Patron Circle.

honorary.name: Volunteer Leader
honorary.granted: Volunteers who have served a chapter, Special Interest Group or committee for over 12 months.

honoraryNote: Honorary recognition is separate from paid membership and is never bought.

concessions.name: Access seats
concessions.details: Each year, 10% of paid seats are free or half price for students from economically weaker backgrounds, students at rural and Tier-3 institutions, women returning to work, persons with disabilities and first-generation graduates.

concessions.name: Founding cohort
concessions.details: The first 500 individuals and the first 25 organisations in the first year get 30% off any tenure, and a Founding Cohort badge.

concessions.name: Referral
concessions.details: Bring in three paid members and your next year is free.

concessions.name: Group
concessions.details: Ten or more individuals from one employer get 15% off.

concessions.name: International
concessions.details: Individuals outside India pay USD 50 a year as a Professional or USD 20 as a Student. Organisations outside India pay by quotation.

concessions.name: Upgrade credit
concessions.details: When you move to a higher category during your term, the unused value of your membership is credited.

rules.title: Apply
rules.text: Fill in the online form with your category, proof of eligibility and acceptance of the Code of Conduct.

rules.title: Approval
rules.text: The Membership sub-committee decides on individual applications within 7 days. Organisations hear within 21 days, with the sign-off of one Board member.

rules.title: Onboarding
rules.text: You receive a receipt, a digital certificate and a member ID, and are invited to a welcome session within 30 days.

rules.title: Renewal
rules.text: We remind you 60, 30 and 7 days before your membership ends. A 30-day grace period follows, with your benefits intact.

rules.title: Lapse
rules.text: After the grace period you return to free Community membership. If you rejoin within 12 months, you keep your seniority.

rules.title: Upgrade
rules.text: You can move to a higher category at any time, and the unused value is credited.

rules.title: Termination
rules.text: For a breach of the Code of Conduct or acting against the trust's objects, by resolution of the Board, after written notice and a chance to respond. There is no refund.

rules.title: Refunds
rules.text: A pro-rata refund within 30 days of joining. After that, fees are not refundable, but an organisation's membership can be transferred within the same organisation.
